objective: Wire startup, shutdown, and request dependencies without changing the public HTTP API.
success_conditions: The default FastAPI lifespan opens an async Redis client and httpx.AsyncClient instances and closes them on shutdown
Chat and health handlers receive settings, Redis, and provider clients through FastAPI dependencies
POST /v1/chat/completions and GET /health keep their current status codes and payloads when the app is configured

tasks.description: Add a lifespan-owned runtime and FastAPI dependency providers, and switch chat and health handlers to those providers.
Prove startup, shutdown, and dependency injection with tests, and document the factory lifespan.
